title: Quiet and dependable
body: This GE dishwasher is much quieter than our old unit and the dishes come out clean even on the normal cycle. The third rack is useful for spatulas and lids, and the stainless interior feels sturdy.
author: Avery

title: Great everyday dishwasher
body: We run this dishwasher almost every night and it has handled plates, glasses, and kids lunch containers without trouble. The racks are easy to load and the controls are straightforward.
author: Morgan

title: Strong cleaning performance
body: The wash performance is excellent and baked-on pasta sauce comes off well. The only small drawback is that the cycle is longer than expected, but the results are worth it.
author: Jordan

title: Sparkling glasses
body: Glasses come out clear with no film and the silverware basket separates utensils nicely. Installation was simple and the dishwasher feels like a big upgrade for the price.
author: Taylor

title: Very happy so far
body: After two months of use, the GE dishwasher has been reliable and easy to maintain. It cleans heavily used cookware better than our previous model.
author: Casey

title: Cleans well but drying is average
body: The dishwasher cleans dishes well, but plastics sometimes remain damp at the end of the cycle. It is not a deal breaker, though I expected stronger drying.
author: Riley

title: Excellent value
body: For the cost, this GE dishwasher offers strong cleaning, quiet operation, and a polished look. The bottle jets are especially helpful for tall glasses.
author: Jamie

title: Easy to load
body: The rack layout makes sense and I can fit more dishes than I could in our older dishwasher. Plates and bowls come out clean without pre-rinsing.
author: Drew

title: Good machine with minor noise
body: Cleaning is very good and the door feels solid. It has a soft humming sound during some cycles, but it is not loud enough to bother us.
author: Quinn

title: Perfect for a busy kitchen
body: We cook daily and this dishwasher keeps up. The heavy cycle removes egg, oatmeal, and sauce residue, and the filter is easy to check.
author: Skyler

title: Love the third rack
body: The third rack is better than I expected. It keeps knives and measuring spoons out of the way, and the main racks still have plenty of room.
author: Harper

title: Dishes stay wet
body: The cleaning is acceptable, but the heating element seems weak or defective because dishes are still wet when the cycle ends. Even ceramic plates need towel drying.
author: Reese

title: Quiet enough for open floor plan
body: Our kitchen opens into the living room and this GE dishwasher is quiet enough to run while watching TV. Dishes have been consistently clean.
author: Peyton

title: Mostly excellent
body: The dishwasher cleans very well and looks great. I wish the lower rack glided a little smoother when fully loaded, but overall it is a solid appliance.
author: Kendall

title: No more pre-rinsing
body: I stopped pre-rinsing most dishes and this dishwasher still gets everything clean. The sensor cycle works well and saves us time after dinner.
author: Logan

title: Great stainless finish
body: The stainless front matches our other appliances and does not show fingerprints as much as expected. Cleaning performance has been excellent.
author: Rowan

title: Fine but not amazing
body: It washes well enough for everyday dishes, but the racks feel a little light and the drying could be better on mugs and plastic storage lids.
author: Cameron

title: Very efficient
body: The dishwasher uses less water than hand washing and still leaves dishes clean. The normal cycle is our default and works for almost everything.
author: Emerson

title: Handles baby bottles well
body: The bottle jets are a real benefit for our family. Bottles and small parts come out clean and we trust the sanitize option.
author: Finley

title: Good upgrade
body: This was a good upgrade from a basic older model. It is quieter, cleans better, and the adjustable rack is helpful for taller items.
author: Dakota

title: Reliable cleaning
body: We have had no issues with missed spots or food left behind. The dishwasher feels dependable and the controls are simple for everyone in the house.
author: Alex

title: Impressive heavy cycle
body: The heavy cycle cleaned a casserole dish that sat overnight. I expected to scrub it, but it came out ready to put away.
author: Sam

title: Bad heating element
body: The dishwasher leaves dishes wet after the cycle ends, and a technician said the heating element was not working properly. I bought it for convenience but now we dry everything by hand.
author: Robin

title: Quiet and clean
body: This GE unit is quiet, attractive, and does exactly what we need. Plates, cups, and utensils all come out clean on the first run.
author: Bailey

title: Great except plastics
body: Everything cleans well, but plastic containers still hold water on top. That may be normal, but it is the only thing keeping this from five stars.
author: Charlie

title: Simple controls
body: The controls are clear and easy to use. I like that I can choose the cycle and options without digging through a complicated menu.
author: Hayden

title: Good for large loads
body: We can load dinner dishes for six people and still have room for pans. The wash arms seem to reach every corner.
author: Elliot

title: Looks premium
body: The dishwasher looks more expensive than it was and runs quietly. Drying is good when rinse aid is full, but weaker without it.
author: Marley

title: Dependable after six months
body: We have used it for six months with no problems. It cleans consistently and the racks have held up well.
author: Remy

title: Great sanitize option
body: The sanitize cycle gives extra confidence for cutting boards and baby items. It takes longer, but the results are excellent.
author: Blair

title: Average drying
body: The dishwasher gets dishes clean, but the drying cycle is just okay. Bowls and glasses often need a few minutes on the counter.
author: Shawn

title: Installer recommended it
body: Our installer said this GE model was a good choice and so far I agree. It is quiet and cleans better than our old dishwasher.
author: Leslie

title: No residue left behind
body: I have not seen detergent residue or food bits since switching to this dishwasher. The filter is easy to remove and rinse.
author: Devon

title: Good family appliance
body: It handles the daily load for our family well. The silverware basket could be a little larger, but cleaning performance is strong.
author: Ari

title: Better than expected
body: I expected a basic dishwasher, but this one feels refined. The racks slide nicely and the dishes come out spotless.
author: Parker

title: Quiet nighttime cycles
body: We often run it after everyone goes to bed. It is quiet enough that it does not wake anyone up.
author: Sage

title: Heating element problem
body: The dishwasher washes the dishes but does not dry them. The heating element appears to be bad because the tub stays cool and dishes are wet after the cycle ends.
author: Kai

title: Great purchase
body: This has been one of the better appliance purchases we have made. It cleans consistently and the interior has plenty of space.
author: Noel

title: Good with rinse aid
body: Drying improved a lot after adding rinse aid. Cleaning was already strong, so now we are satisfied with the whole cycle.
author: Lane

title: Excellent for pots
body: I was surprised how well it handled pots and mixing bowls. We still scrape food, but we rarely need to scrub after washing.
author: Micah

title: Modern and practical
body: The dishwasher looks modern without being flashy. It is practical, quiet, and easy to use every day.
author: Chris

title: Decent but slow
body: The dishes are clean, but the cycles run longer than I expected. It is fine if we start it before bed.
author: Pat

title: Happy with the drying
body: With rinse aid, most dishes come out dry and ready for the cabinet. Glasses look great and silverware is clean.
author: Dana

title: Great lower rack
body: The lower rack fits dinner plates, serving bowls, and pans without awkward rearranging. Cleaning has been reliable.
author: Lee

title: Almost perfect
body: The dishwasher is quiet and cleans well. The only thing I dislike is that the control labels are a little hard to see in dim light.
author: Francis

title: No complaints
body: It works exactly as promised. We load it, run normal cycle, and unload clean dishes the next morning.
author: Rene

title: Good build quality
body: The door closes firmly and the stainless tub gives the dishwasher a quality feel. It is not flimsy like our last one.
author: Jules

title: Wet dishes every time
body: The heating element is bad and dishes are wet after every cycle. Customer support suggested rinse aid, but the inside never gets warm enough to dry properly.
author: Andy

title: Excellent cleaning on normal
body: We mostly use normal cycle and everything comes out clean. I appreciate not having to select heavy wash for everyday messes.
author: Kim

title: Solid dishwasher
body: This is a solid dishwasher for the money. It cleans well, runs quietly, and only struggles with water pooling on cup bottoms.
author: Terry

title: Great for entertaining
body: After hosting dinner, we loaded wine glasses, plates, and utensils and everything came out clean. It saved a lot of cleanup time.
author: Jackie

title: User friendly
body: The controls are intuitive and the status lights are helpful. Everyone in our household figured it out quickly.
author: Shannon

title: Good cleaning but racks feel light
body: The wash result is good, but the rack material feels lighter than expected. I hope it holds up over time.
author: Tracy

title: Very clean silverware
body: The silverware basket separates forks and spoons well, so we do not get nested utensils with food left between them.
author: Amari

title: Quiet workhorse
body: This GE dishwasher has become a quiet workhorse in our kitchen. It runs daily and has been dependable.
author: Jess

title: Good purchase overall
body: It cleans well and looks nice. I removed one star because the top rack needed adjustment for taller glasses.
author: Stevie

title: Great after remodel
body: We installed this during a kitchen remodel and it fits the new space perfectly. Performance has matched the look.
author: Frankie

title: Handles stuck-on breakfast
body: Dried oatmeal and egg usually come off without a second wash. That alone makes this dishwasher worth it.
author: Reagan

title: Does not dry well
body: The bad heating element leaves dishes wet after the cycle ends. The wash is fine, but unloading wet plates and bowls is frustrating.
author: Marion

title: Fantastic upgrade
body: This is a fantastic upgrade from our old noisy dishwasher. It is quieter, roomier, and much better at cleaning.
author: Shiloh

title: Good with minor quirks
body: The dishwasher performs well, but the door has to be pushed firmly to latch. Once it starts, it cleans beautifully.
author: River

title: Consistent results
body: Every load has been consistent. I do not find food stuck to plates or cloudy glassware anymore.
author: Corey

title: Love the bottle jets
body: Bottle jets clean tall cups better than the old top rack did. It is a small feature that makes a big difference.
author: Adrian

title: Average for price
body: It is a good dishwasher, but not exceptional. Cleaning is reliable, while drying and rack smoothness are only average.
author: Jean

title: Quiet during calls
body: I work from home near the kitchen and can run the dishwasher during calls. It is quiet enough that no one notices.
author: Robin C

title: Great cycle options
body: The cycle options are flexible without being confusing. Heavy wash handles pans and normal handles everyday dishes.
author: Angel

title: Happy but use rinse aid
body: We are happy with the dishwasher. Drying is best when rinse aid is topped off, so keep an eye on that.
author: Harley

title: Cleans coffee mugs
body: Our coffee mugs used to retain stains, but this GE dishwasher cleans them well. The interior also stays fresh.
author: Dallas

title: Strong spray arms
body: The spray coverage seems strong. Even bowls on the upper rack come out clean when loaded correctly.
author: Justice

title: Heating element failed
body: The heating element failed early and dishes are wet after the cycle ends. The dishwasher cleans food off, but the drying failure makes every load feel unfinished.
author: Oakley

title: Excellent quiet rating
body: This dishwasher is much quieter than expected. We can barely hear it from the next room.
author: Kelly

title: Good for the price
body: It has a few plastic pieces that feel basic, but the actual washing performance is very good for the price.
author: Linden

title: Easy maintenance
body: The filter is easy to access and rinse. We have not had odors or drainage problems.
author: Monroe

title: Great drying with settings
body: Using the heated dry setting and rinse aid gives us dry plates and clean glasses. Very satisfied.
author: Phoenix

title: Usable but not premium
body: It works and cleans well, but the racks do not feel as premium as the exterior looks. Overall it is acceptable.
author: Sutton

title: Family approved
body: Everyone in the house likes this dishwasher. It is easy to load, quiet, and dependable.
author: Jamie L

title: No spots on glass
body: We have hard water and still get clean glasses with very little spotting. That was a pleasant surprise.
author: Aubrey

title: Good replacement
body: This replaced a much older dishwasher and the difference is obvious. It is quieter and cleans better, though cycles are longer.
author: Brook

title: Very pleased
body: We have been very pleased with this GE dishwasher. It handles daily messes without drama.
author: Ellis

title: Great kitchen helper
body: It saves time after cooking and keeps the sink clear. The dishes look clean and smell fresh.
author: Gray

title: Wet after heated dry
body: Even with heated dry selected, dishes are wet after the cycle ends. It seems like the heating element is bad or underpowered.
author: Hollis

title: Excellent cleaning power
body: The cleaning power is excellent. Sauce, cereal, and tea stains come off without needing a second wash.
author: Indigo

title: Good but small silverware slots
body: I like the dishwasher overall, but some larger handled utensils do not fit the silverware slots. Cleaning is strong.
author: Jonah

title: Looks and works great
body: The appliance looks great in our kitchen and performs well. We are glad we chose this GE model.
author: Kerry

title: Dependable normal cycle
body: The normal cycle is dependable for most loads. I rarely need to use heavy wash unless cookware is very dirty.
author: Lake

title: Okay drying performance
body: The dishwasher cleans well, but drying is mixed. Plates are mostly dry while cups and plastics often need a towel.
author: Milan

title: Great after dinner parties
body: It handles large dinner party loads well. Wine glasses, plates, and silverware all came out clean.
author: Nico

title: Quiet and attractive
body: The front panel is clean and attractive, and the machine is quiet enough for our open kitchen.
author: Orion

title: Good sanitize feature
body: The sanitize feature is helpful and gives peace of mind. The longer cycle time is the only tradeoff.
author: Presley

title: Great rack flexibility
body: The adjustable rack makes it easier to fit tall glasses and odd-shaped bowls. Cleaning has been excellent.
author: Quincy

title: Cleans without soaking
body: I no longer soak most dishes before loading. Scraped plates come out clean on the first wash.
author: Rory

title: Persistent heating issue
body: The heating element appears defective because every load ends with wet dishes. The dishwasher washes but never dries, which is a major disappointment.
author: Sasha

title: Good choice
body: This GE dishwasher was a good choice for our kitchen. It is reliable and easy to operate.
author: Tatum

title: Mostly dry dishes
body: Most dishes are dry when the cycle is done, though plastic lids still collect water. Cleaning performance is excellent.
author: Urban

title: Great for cookware
body: Pots and pans fit well on the lower rack. The heavy cycle gets them clean without much scrubbing.
author: Val

title: Quiet startup
body: The dishwasher starts quietly and does not make loud draining noises. It feels refined compared with our old one.
author: Winter

title: Fine appliance
body: This is a fine appliance. It cleans dishes well but does not feel especially premium in the rack design.
author: Xander

title: Excellent silverware cleaning
body: Silverware comes out clean even when the basket is full. We have had no stuck-on food between utensils.
author: Yara

title: Very satisfied
body: We are very satisfied with the cleaning, noise level, and interior space. I would buy this model again.
author: Zion

title: Good dishwasher with long cycles
body: It cleans very well, but the standard cycle takes longer than our previous dishwasher. We usually run it overnight.
author: Alden

title: Great with glassware
body: Glassware comes out clear and shiny. We have not had issues with cloudiness or spots.
author: Briar

title: Easy install and use
body: Installation went smoothly and the dishwasher has been simple to use. It performs well on everyday dishes.
author: Cedar

title: Bad drying system
body: The heating element seems bad because dishes are wet after cycle ends. The cleaning cycle works, but unloading is frustrating when everything needs hand drying.
author: Dorian

title: Strong performer
body: This dishwasher is a strong performer in a busy household. It handles breakfast, lunch, and dinner dishes well.
author: Ever

title: Useful top rack
body: The top rack is useful for small items and utensils. I wish it had a little more clearance, but it works well.
author: Fallon

title: Quiet and efficient
body: It is quiet, efficient, and leaves dishes clean. We are using fewer paper plates because cleanup is easier.
author: Greer

title: Happy with purchase
body: The dishwasher met our expectations. It looks good, runs quietly, and cleans dishes thoroughly.
author: Haven

title: Good washer weak dryer
body: The washing side is good, but the drying side is weaker than expected. Some loads need extra air-drying.
author: Isa

title: Excellent for daily use
body: For daily use, this dishwasher is excellent. The racks hold plenty and the normal cycle is reliable.
author: Jory

title: No food particles
body: I have not found food particles left on dishes since buying it. The spray pattern seems very effective.
author: Koa

title: Good but not silent
body: It is quiet but not completely silent. Cleaning is strong and the look is clean.
author: Lior

title: Great upgrade for condo
body: This was a great upgrade for our condo kitchen. It is compact enough for the space but still holds a full load.
author: Marlow

title: Excellent interior space
body: The interior space is better than expected. We can load big bowls, plates, and mugs without crowding.
author: Nova

title: Heating element leaves dishes wet
body: The bad heating element leaves dishes wet after cycle ends, even on heated dry. We have to towel dry plates, cups, and silverware every time.
author: Onyx

title: Dependable appliance
body: The dishwasher has been dependable and easy to use. It gets dishes clean without needing a lot of attention.
author: Pax

title: Good cleaning less great drying
body: Cleaning is excellent, but drying is only good when we use rinse aid and leave the door closed for a while.
author: Raine

title: Perfect for weeknights
body: Weeknight cleanup is much easier now. We load everything after dinner and wake up to clean dishes.
author: Sloane

title: Would recommend
body: I would recommend this GE dishwasher to anyone who wants a quiet and reliable machine at a reasonable price.
author: Tobin

title: Acceptable dishwasher
body: It is acceptable overall. Cleaning is good, but the racks could be sturdier and drying could be more consistent.
author: Uma

title: Excellent cleaning results
body: The cleaning results are excellent across plates, bowls, glasses, and utensils. It makes the kitchen routine easier.
author: Vega
